parameters.name: date

schema.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the current period.
schema.title: Date

parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to the current period.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to get the next (older) page. Null on the last page.

performed_by_user_id.title: Performed By User Id
performed_by_user_id.description: Who physically made / checked the batch, on a shared device. Must be an active member. Defaults to the signed-in user (always recorded as signatory).

signatory_user_id.title: Signatory User Id
signatory_user_id.description: The signed-in account that saved it.

item_type.description: `bool`: Так/Ні, «Ні» is the deviation. `numeric`: a measured value, outside [min_value, max_value] is the deviation. Fixed after creation.

ControlChecklistItemUpdateRequest.title: ControlChecklistItemUpdateRequest
ControlChecklistItemUpdateRequest.description:
Partial update. Send only what changes; send `null` to open a bound.
The item type cannot change.

ControlRecordStatus.title: ControlRecordStatus
ControlRecordStatus.description:
`draft` while items are being checked one by one; `submitted` once
finalized. After submission, item changes are amendments that require a
reason and are logged as `item_amended`.

period_date.title: Period Date
period_date.description: Day (or, for monthly controls, any day within the month) being filled in. Defaults to today in the organization's timezone. Cannot be in the future.

record_id.title: Record Id
record_id.description: Null until the first item is checked.

performed_by_user_id.title: Performed By User Id
performed_by_user_id.description: Who physically did it, on a shared device. Must be an active member. Defaults to the signed-in user (always recorded as `responsible_user_id`).

responsible_user_id.title: Responsible User Id
responsible_user_id.description: The signed-in account that saved it.

status.title: Status
status.description: Required for Yes/No items. Ignored for numeric items: the server judges `value` against the item's range.

value.title: Value
value.description: Required for numeric items (the measured reading); not allowed for Yes/No items. Outside the range = `deviation`, which needs a corrective action.

corrective_action.title: Corrective Action
corrective_action.description: Required (min 3 characters) when status is `deviation`; ignored for `pass`.

amendment_reason.title: Amendment Reason
amendment_reason.description: Required (min 3 characters) when the record is already submitted.

performed_by_user_id.title: Performed By User Id
performed_by_user_id.description: Who physically did the check, on a shared device. Must be an active member. Defaults to the signed-in user, who is always recorded as well.

period_date.title: Period Date
period_date.description: Day (or any day within the month) to check. Defaults to the current period in the organization's timezone. Cannot be in the future.

min_value.title: Min Value
min_value.description: Numeric items: the limits the current value was judged against (the item's current limits until it is first measured).

checked_by.description: The signed-in account that saved it.
